facts.fact: Decreto n.º 10/2025, published in Boletim Oficial n.º 12 (4.º Suplemento) of 28 March 2025 after Council of Ministers approval on 13 March, approves the ENTD.GW 2025-2030 as an integral annex, which calls itself the country's most comprehensive digital strategy.
facts.system: Estratégia Nacional para a Transformação Digital (ENTD.GW) 2025-2030

facts.fact: The full text of the ENTD.GW is public as the annex to the gazetted decree, and its stated period is 2025-2030.
facts.system: Estratégia Nacional para a Transformação Digital (ENTD.GW) 2025-2030

facts.fact: The ENTD.GW sets 55 interventions under six strategic objectives, each with a stated start, end and duration in months (for example interventions 46 to 51 between January 2025 and June 2026); the passages read state no cost for them.
